hooks.command: cd /Users/giacomomeschini/Claude/MappAI && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git add -A && MSG="WIP: auto-save $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" && git commit -m "$MSG" && git push origin "$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null && echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"💾 Auto-salvato su '$BRANCH'\"}" ; fi
